question: Energy ceasefire: real truce, or just words?

lines.text: Zelensky says Russia hit Ukrainian power plants, hours after Donald Trump announced an energy ceasefire.
lines.note: Zelensky, 11 Oct evening (Telegram / nightly address); first reported about 16:45 UTC 11 Oct

lines.text: Today, grid operator Ukrenergo has hourly power cuts in some regions, after Russian strikes.
lines.note: Ukrinform 12 Oct: hourly outage schedules 06:00 to 23:59 on Monday in certain regions, due to the consequences of Russian strikes on energy infrastructure (Ukrenergo on Facebook)

lines.text: On Sunday, Trump posted: Effective immediately, there is an energy ceasefire in the war between Russia and Ukraine.
lines.note: Trump on Truth Social, 11 Oct (Euronews verbatim)

scene.quote: Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine.

lines.text: He added: Both sides have agreed. No terms, no monitoring.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: 'Both sides have agreed. Do not violate it!'; post did not outline monitoring or terms

lines.text: Zelensky's reply: It was news for me. But if Russians agree to an energy ceasefire, Ukraine will agree.

scene.quote: It was news for me. But if Russians agree to an energy ceasefire, Ukraine will agree.

lines.text: He says Ukraine's army has orders to comply.
lines.note: Kyiv Post: Ukraine's armed forces had received orders to comply with the ceasefire

lines.text: Then, he says, Russia hit Kharkiv's CHP-5 power plant.
lines.note: Zelensky: 'Just now there was a strike on CHP-5 in Kharkiv' (Euromaidan Press); Kharkiv's second-largest power plant

lines.text: A drone also hit a Kyiv power station, cutting power in several districts.
lines.note: Euronews and Kyiv Post: Kyiv power plant hit by a drone, outages in several districts

lines.text: Zelensky says Russia made over 200 strikes on Ukraine's power system this week.
lines.note: Zelensky: more than 200 strikes on power generation and transmission this week (Euromaidan Press)

lines.text: Moscow has not confirmed any agreement.
lines.note: Euronews 12 Oct: 'Russia has not yet confirmed this agreement.'

lines.text: In London, Prime Minister Andy Burnham backed Trump's call for a sustained energy ceasefire.
lines.note: Euronews: Burnham echoed support and Trump's call 'for a sustained energy ceasefire to start now' (spoken line paraphrases)

lines.text: Oil fell. Brent crude is down one and a half per cent, to about 103 dollars.
lines.note: HDFC Sky 12 Oct: Brent futures down 1.5% to $103; WTI down 1.8% to $90.2
